rationale: Worktrees remain preserved and abandon is idempotent.
The runtime does not apply model-authored conflict patches.

replacement: native request_user_input and Stop waiting marker
rationale: User waiting is represented by the native interaction surface.
Bare mode cannot provide the required role and candidate isolation.
Reviewer evidence is bound to an isolated integrated candidate.
Conflicts never auto-apply or overwrite target state.
A session can own only one active run and cannot capture another run.
Plan validation freezes the delivery level before execution.
Exact dirty files enter Builder without mutating target or global stash.
Documentation correctness remains an independent review gate.
Bare execution was removed with bare mode.
Tracked, untracked and ignored candidate residue blocks pass.
Blackbox evidence is a distinct mandatory gate.
Evidence can cross HEAD only when its frozen inputs are unchanged.

replacement: protected inputs plus deterministic progress stops
rationale: Control-path tampering is rejected and repeated failures require review.
A repository without a commit has no provable Git baseline.
E2E targets, behavior coverage, mechanical rules, verification and quality criteria are frozen directly rather than inferred from prose.
Evidence is accepted only from the recorded role thread and turn.
Reinstall replaces only managed handlers.
Foreign configuration and symlink targets are preserved.
An external Judge model is outside the deterministic runtime boundary.
Judge-specific heuristics no longer define completion.
External Judge environment loading is no longer part of the product.
Review cannot override missing machine or Tester evidence.
The adapter does not own model fallback policy.

replacement: session id and repository ledger discovery
rationale: Run selection does not infer ownership from CWD heuristics.
Target identity is explicit even when another checkout is detached.
Dirty state stops finalization while preserving worktrees.
CAS, sync and cleanup are persisted and retryable.
All owned and orphan worktrees are reported with precise state.
A newly initialized repository works after its first immutable commit.
No-diff turns do not require transcript-driven hook nudges.
Prompt nudging is replaced by explicit runtime facts.
Issue observation expiry is unrelated to delivery correctness.

replacement: complete active-v2 continuation under the v3 runtime
rationale: Existing active v2 runs retain run, thread, candidate and finalize-intent identity through completion while new v2 plans are rejected.
Unknown worktrees are diagnosed but never silently adopted or deleted.
Builder and Tester start from the same frozen baseline when allowed.
Machine commands execute against the committed candidate.
Review remains mandatory after deterministic verification passes.
A side-channel pause file is unnecessary and creates a second state source.

replacement: explicit frozen plan path and markers
rationale: The runtime does not heuristically discover plans.
Reviewer completion uses a stable structured marker.
Review cannot be started before required evidence exists.

replacement: protected runner paths plus Reviewer test audit
rationale: Runner weakening and test bypasses cannot silently create PASS.
Commands, timeouts and working directory are validated before execution.
Transcript cursors are not a reliable source of execution truth.
Diagnostics are structured around runtime facts rather than hook text logs.

replacement: repository lock and staged final commit
rationale: Concurrent finalization and commit hooks are transactionally guarded.

replacement: run id plus session and agent identity
rationale: Slug and CWD inference are replaced by explicit identities.
Only committed candidate trees can produce evidence and final commits.
Corrupt or missing state is reported and never silently discarded.
